(449)༄༅/'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying tig gi sgrub chen dngos gzhi'i gtor ma ni/rig 'dzin 'dus pa la/bang rim gru bzhi bzhi brtsegs/ra

tei:div.tei:p: (449) ༄༅/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying tig gi sgrub chen dngos gzhi'i gtor ma ni/

rig 'dzin 'dus pa la/ bang rim gru bzhi bzhi brtsegs/ rin chen zur brgyad/ nyi zla/ zhi gtor dmar po/ ༈ thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa la/ gdan bzhi brtsegs/ rtsibs brgyad/ nyi zla/ dpal gtor dmar po 'dab bzhi can/ ༈ gshin rje 'chi bdag zil gnon la/ dpal gtor dmar po 'khor brgyad/ ༈ rta mgrin khams gsum rol pa la/ dpal gtor dmar po 'khor drug ༈ yang dag sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la/ dmar gtor dmar po 'khor brgyad/ ༈ phur pa bdud 'dul zil gnon la/ dpal gtor dmar po 'khor bcu bzhi/ ༈ yum bka' bde chen rgyal mo la/ chos 'byung nyis bsnol/ mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma 'dab bzhi/ ༈ bka' srung ma mgon lcam dral la/ dpal gtor dmar po/ g.yas su zur gsum/ g.yon du zur gsum ra mgos mtshan pa/ rgyab dmar gtor g.yas gcus/ mdun du dmar gtor/ ༈ legs ldan la mkhar thabs kha bad steng zur gsum/ mdun du yum zur gsum/ mthar dmar gtor bcu gnyis/ ༈ tshogs bdag la/ bang rim bzhi/ dpal gtor/ mdun g.yon yum bshos/ logs gsum rang 'dra gsum/ ༈ gza' la/ dmar gtor g.yas gcus/ 'khor brgyad/ kyu gu bzhi/ (450)༈ gnod sbyin la dmar gtor 'khor brgyad/ ༈ srog sgrub mar/ dmar gtor 'khor bzhi/ ༈ tshe ring mar/ gdan gru bzhi nyis brtsegs/ khang bzang*/ kha bad/ rgya phibs steng nor bu 'bar ba/ zur bzhir/ bum pa 'brang rgyas nor bus mtshan pa bzhi/ ༈ g.yu sgron mar/ bshos zlum gtso 'khor lnga/ ༈ dur khrod lha mo la/ dmar gtor gtso 'khor brgyad/ ༈ btsan la/ gdan gru bzhi/ mkhar thabs/ kha bad steng*/ dmar gtor/ 'khor drug de rgyab dmar gtor brgyad/ ༈ rgyal po la/ bang rim gsum/ rgyal bshos gshog drug gtso 'khor lnga/ zur bzhir ting lo/ 'khor dmar po brgyad/ ༈ dgongs btsan la/ dmar gtor 'khor drug ༈ sku gsum mar/ bang rim gsum/ bla gtor 'dab bzhi/ 'khor lha bshos bzhi/ ril bu don lnga/ chang bu bzhi/ ༈ gtor bsngos bla ma yi dam la/ pho rgyud dpung rong 'khor brtsi med/

༈ ma mgon 'khrugs skong la/ bang rim bzhi/ chos 'byung bsnol ma/ mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma 'dab bzhi/ ༈ bam skong la/ bam ro me thab sgrog 'ching*/ lag g.yas g.yon glo (451) snying*/ mgo thog dmar gtor/ ༈ chad tho la dmar gtor mtheb skyu brgyad can/ ༈ brtan ma dmar gtor g.yas gru bzhi/ g.yon zlum pa mtheb skyu sum brtsegs can/ de rnams 'khor mtheb skyu grangs med rgyab/ phrag rgyan/ nyi zla me ri can no/ ༈ rtsa gtor gsum/ 'di che chung med pa 'dra mnyam/ thams cad rgyan khra can dgos/ yang dag la sgrub rten mar me zla gam dgu dgos/ sgrub pa skabs mchod gtor dgos grangs/ sa chog la/ bdag bskyed gtor ma/ sa lha dkar gtor mtheb ril can gnyis/ cha gsum/ rgyal tho bzhi la dkar gtor re/ sgo byang dmar gtor/ ma traṃ bcas/ ༈ rgyan bkod la/ dkar bgegs/ tshogs gsol ka cha gsum/ chad brtan/ zhi sbyong gsum/ drag sbyong gsum/ tsā ru gro zan chang bu/ zho zan chang bu/ gnyer gtad dmar gtor/ ༈ dngos gzhi nyin 'grigs la/ dkar bgegs/ tshogs gsol ka chad brtan/ cha gsum/ rgyal tho dkar gtor bzhi/ sgo byang dmar gtor gcig mtshan thun du byed la lcog rdog de grangs/ nyin mtshan dus drug la/ bsang gsur/ nyin gzhung mchod pa phud skong*/ ༈ grol nyin/ dngos grub gtor ma rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ zan chang gi tshogs shin tu chen po gcig bca'/ ( bsgo dus sgom sgom re bca' ?) / (452) ༈ sbyin sreg zhi ba la/ bla gtor dkar po gnyis/ ༈ rgyas pa la/ bshos bu gru bzhi ser po/ rtsa bar pad 'dab bzhi sbyar ba gnyis/ dbang la/ bshos bu zla gam rtsa bar pad 'dab gcig sbyar ba gnyis/ drag po la gru gsum nag po gcig ༈ mchog gi sbyin sreg la/ bla gtor dmar po gnyis/ tshogs gcig bca' dgos/ sgrub rten thod chang bzhag pa grol nyin dngos grub len chog dus 'gyed rgyu yin/ nyin drug pa'i rgyun gyi dngos grub blang ba dang*/ nyin bdun pa'i srod la dngos grub len chog gnyis la thod chang gsar pa re bsham dgos/

sgrub rten nang tshe chang tshe ril bzhag pa grol nyin 'gyed dgos/ thod pa gnyis nang sman raka phab gta' la phye 'phur drod can nang chang phab cung zad re btab te bsnyal/ sgrub pa zhag dus sman nang ka ra dang*/ rak+ta/ btsag gis spel te bla grwa so so la bgo rgyu byas na legs/ ༈ sta gon la dbang chas/ khrus bum/ bgegs gtor/ gul yungs/ dri thig so shing*/ dor gdan/ rung chu/ dpung skud/ ku sha bcas dgos/ ༈ rab gnas la/ bum pa bcu gcig rab gnas me tog 'dag chal bzhi/ bsku mnye/ dril phyis/ sku phyi/ na bza'/ tsaka li rnams/ spos thur/ mchod yon dung chu/ (453) lha khrus byon par/ khrus bum/ me long*/ khrus dar/ 'thor nas/ rab gnas byon dus rab gnas me tog ༈ dngos gzhi'i dus/ dkar bgegs/ byin 'bebs la g.yab dar/ dkyil 'khor bskor/ spyan 'dren g.yab dar/ sman raka sbreng*/ bsnyen pa'i stong tshig rnams la mchod kha gso/ tho gsos la dkar gtor bzhi/ dmar gtor gcig rnam lnga las bum/ 'thor nas bcas/ phyi chog la/ bgegs bdug byin 'bebs/ spyan 'dren gnyis/ g.yab dar/ sman raka sbreng*/ rnam bum/ las bum sgrub dus bum pa'i khar dung chu'i steng gzungs rdor gzungs thag sne slob dpon la phul/ 'od zhu skabs dung chu bum par blugs/ gsol ka la/ gtor 'bul bshams/ phud bshal/ sbreng nas 'gyed/ sku gsum brgyud gsum mthar phud bshal mchod/ cha gsum gtor ma gsum/ na rag skong bshags la phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa bkyags/ mar me'i smon lam mthar/ tshogs la las bum chu/ bla ma'i nang mchod/ tshogs chang sbran/ mchod bshags gnyis bkyags/ sgral ba bla ma'i mdun bzhag rak+ta sbran/ nang thig bcas zhal bstab bkyags/ skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu/ mdor na rab 'byams dus/ bar bshags de phyi rol gnam phud du mchod/ bdag 'jug la/ khrus la las bum sgros chu gtor/ bgegs bdug mig (454) dar/ me tog 'gyed/ dam chu rung chu 'gyed/ byin 'bebs la g.yab dar/

dkyil 'khor la tshogs pas bskor/ las bum/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ rdor dril bsnol ma/ rnam bum/ gsang thod/ rig tsaka me long shel rdo bcas/ tshogs drang ba/ lhag ma la lhag dkyil steng rnam lnga skor bsham/ sgral bas gtsang lhag bya/ tshogs ba'i gsol lhag gi gtsog lhag yar gnas mar gnas bsre res/ mthar gtsog lhag steng gtsang lhag blugs/ sman raka bran/ lhag zhus/ kha phru gdab/ dpal 'bar btsugs/ zhwa bcas/ lhag ma brtson 'dzin/ gsol ka bkyags pa la/ gtor 'bul me sgron bcas lag g.yas/ sbreng thur gnyis steng phud phor g.yon zhwa bcas phyir dor/ chad tho me sgron bcas g.yas/ brtan ma g.yon zhwa bcas/ phyi dor/ zhwa gyon bzhin/ gtor gzhong gral mdor sbub/ slob dpaun gyi rdo rje zhus ste rgya gram dgaud/ zhwa phud/ rdo rje yar phul/ gtor gzhong yar khyer/ lhag ma bshal ba'i chu brtan gtor nang blug dgos/ mchod bstod mchod kha gso/ nyul+le/ e raṃ dus lcags khang bzhag slob dpon la g.yab dar/ 'gugs pa gsum/ slob dpon la phur pa/ ṭa ki 'cham dus brub khung slob dpon mdun/ ṭa ki drag sngags so lnga 'cham 'ong dus 'cham pa gnyis bar du rdo thun len ma rag bzhag 'cham (455) pa phyir 'gro tshar dus/ brub khung g.yas g.yon/ rdo thun dang*/ gri gnyis len ma rag bzhag 'cham pa tshur 'ong rdo thun lan gnyis brab tshar ma khad/ brub khung rdo thun bsnun/ shar phyogs dkar mo'i mthar/ bgegs bdug ging ṭa ki rdor mtshams slob dpon bcas pas dkyil 'khor tshogs pa bskor/ byin 'bebs la g.yab dar/ ༈ nyin bdun par/ sbyin sreg sa chog sar cha gsum/ dkar gtor lnga/ chag chag dri chu/ las bum bcas/ nang du tshom bu bkod rgyu/ zhi ba la dkar gtor/ rgyas pa ser/ dbang dmar/ drag po ljang*/ mchog mthing ga bkod/ sbyin sreg tshon thig gzhung ltar/ phar byon dus/ phur pa/ gzhung chen/ rta mgrin/ gshin rje/ yang dag tshur byon dus/ gzhung chen/ rta mgrin/ gshin rje/

yang dag phur pa bcas/ sbyin sreg sar/ las bzhi phyogs bzhir kha gyu/ yang dag dbus su bzhugs/ shar du zhal gyu/ bla ma'i g.yon du mchod gzhi/ g.yas su sreg rdzas/ mdun du me thab zhi ba zlum po/ rgyas pa gru bzhi/ dbang zla gam/ drag po zur gsum/ mchog zlum po/ dgang blugs/ mda' dar/ rlung g.yab/ mda' bzhi srad bus bres/ thab 'geb las mdog yam shing*/ mar khu/ rdzas sder brgyad re/ yungs dkar sogs bsham/ de nang (456) las byang*/ gsol ka tshogs bskul pa la/ g.yab dar/ nyul+le ling ga dngos grub len chog shar phyogs dkar mo mthar/ me hom gru gsum du bsreg byin 'bebs la g.yab dar/ dngos grub dus dbang rdzas sgrub rten dngos grub rnams 'gyed/ dbang la khrus/ bgegs gtor/ mig dar me tog ye shes dbab/ las bum/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ rnam bum/ lha tsaka gsang thod/ rig tsaka me long*/ shel rdo/ gzhung pod bcas/ de nas sbyin sreg mdzad/ khrom dbang bskur/ lhag ma/ gsol ka chad brtan/ bro sogs/ rgyal tho/ sgo byang*/ khro bcu/ rdul tshon bsdu/ mar me'i smon lam/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis bcas/ phyir nyin rig 'dus tshogs skong rgyas pa/ khang steng du du ba mthong grol/ chu khar rdul tshon chur byo bas chu bo dbyings khyab/ yar log bsngo smon bkra shis bcas// dge'o//
